entities.summary: Belgorod State Technological University named after V.G. Shukhov (BSTU) is a technological university based in Belgorod, Russia. It specializes in the field of the construction materials. It trains experts for the construction industry and for other fields. Belgorod State Technological University is a research institute in Europe, established in 1954-04-29. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
